Inability to spray anywhere but a specific dedicated map of the wall sucks. Graffism VR has the game beat in this aspect drastically. Also seems regularly updated and like a much better competitor. As a general experience, VR graff oesn't translate into real life experience as you'd hope. The steam version, while superior in many ways (custom maps etc) just isn't updated at all either, which stinks. If you're genuinely trying to get better at can control, cheap spray paint with good caps at a legal wall is a better learning aid. But if you just want a more fun 3D blackbook or are just itching to paint despite the weather not allowing it, this is an option, although I'd say get Graffism VR instead.
